self.title: What If Our Starting Assumptions Are Wrong?

detail.title: Foundational Epistemic Self-Falsification
detail.question: How can an autonomous system identify and formally challenge its own foundational epistemic axioms?
detail.reason: Attention governance requires prioritization of assumption_challenge; no existing project addresses the formal identification and testing of foundational reasoning axioms.

detail.title: Foundational Assumption Testing and Epistemic Self-Correction

detail.reason: Continuing structured inquiry into assumption testing.
